tr.summary: The essay answers the outweigh question directly ("I believe that the advantages are more significant") and keeps that position. The point about young staff learning faster is left without an example.

cc.summary: Paragraphing is logical with one idea per body paragraph. The fixed phrase "In the other hand" is wrong and linking relies on a few common connectors.

lr.summary: Vocabulary is mostly precise ("flexible arrangements", "practical solutions") with some imprecise choices such as "the border between work and home".

gra.summary: A mix of complex and simple sentences, but slips such as "has became" and "they has" recur.

grammar_corrections.reason: After has, use the past participle: become.
Cars are countable, so use fewer.
The fixed linking phrase is on the other hand.
The plural subject they takes have.

structure_advice: The four-paragraph structure suits the question. Make the thesis preview both body paragraphs and keep new ideas out of the conclusion.
strengths: Clear position stated in the introduction and repeated in the conclusion.
A specific example: the colleague who stopped commuting.
One main idea per body paragraph.
top_3_priorities: Check subject and verb agreement ("they has").
Support every body idea with an example.
Learn fixed linking phrases ("On the other hand").
